build_RawCache: build a RawCache for a Transformer model with a specified per-layer cache length and device
build_like_RawCache: build a RawCache matching another cache's shape with optional pinned host memory
view_RawCache: view a slice of a RawCache along the sequence axis starting at a given offset
prepare_lane_Cache: prepare a DynCacheLane from a host Cache by matching token blocks against the trie
maintain_Cache: maintain the host Cache by evicting least-recently-used nodes to stay within the token limit
